name: Bedrock add-on
summary: An add-on for Minecraft: Bedrock Edition: a behavior pack and a resource pack that belong together, with an optional script.
description: Two pack folders, each with its own manifest.json and fresh UUIDs, and the dependency that ties the behavior pack to the resource pack. As options: a script that uses @minecraft/server, a function, and a text change in the resource pack. Nothing to build.

options.label: Add-on name
options.patternHelp: start with a letter; letters, digits, spaces, - and _ only

options.label: Author
options.patternHelp: start with a letter; letters, digits, spaces, - and _ only

options.label: Description
options.help: Shown under the pack's name in the game.

options.label: Minimum game version
options.help: The oldest Bedrock version the packs are written for, written the way manifest.json wants it. Bedrock 26.60 is 1, 26, 60.

options.label: @minecraft/server version
options.help: The scripting API the script asks for. 2.11.0 is the newest stable one and needs Bedrock 26.60. A game older than that does not run the script, so lower this for older games.

options.label: Script
options.help: A scripts/main.js that greets each player who joins.

options.label: Example function
options.help: A function you can run with /function.

options.label: Example text change
options.help: The resource pack renames the stick, so you can see it is active.

next: Copy the _BP folder into development_behavior_packs and the _RP folder into development_resource_packs, both under %APPDATA%\Minecraft Bedrock\Users\Shared\games\com.mojang
Start Minecraft, create a world, and under Behavior Packs activate the add-on. The resource pack is added with it.
Enter the world: the script greets you in chat.
After editing a script or function, run /reload in the world. After editing a manifest, restart the game.
Your code starts in scripts\main.js in the behavior pack.
